description: This file contains implementation of the QuicSessionPeer class with static methods for testing and manipulating QuicSession objects in the QUIC protocol, including stream ID management, stream activation, and state queries.

classes.name: QuicSessionPeer
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods to access and manipulate internal states of QuicSession objects for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetNextOutgoingBidirectionalStreamId
methods.description: Returns the next outgoing bidirectional stream ID for a given session.

methods.name: GetNextOutgoingUnidirectionalStreamId
methods.description: Returns the next outgoing unidirectional stream ID for a given session.

methods.name: SetNextOutgoingBidirectionalStreamId
methods.description: Sets the next outgoing bidirectional stream ID for a session, depending on transport version.

methods.name: SetMaxOpenIncomingStreams
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of open incoming streams, with version-specific behavior.

methods.name: SetMaxOpenIncomingBidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of incoming bidirectional streams, only for IETF QUIC.

methods.name: SetMaxOpenIncomingUnidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of incoming unidirectional streams, only for IETF QUIC.

methods.name: SetMaxOpenOutgoingStreams
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of outgoing streams, deprecated for IETF QUIC.

methods.name: SetMaxOpenOutgoingBidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Allows new outgoing bidirectional streams for IETF QUIC.

methods.name: SetMaxOpenOutgoingUnidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Allows new outgoing unidirectional streams for IETF QUIC.

methods.name: GetMutableCryptoStream
methods.description: Returns a mutable pointer to the crypto stream of the session.

methods.name: GetWriteBlockedStreams
methods.description: Returns the list of write-blocked streams.

methods.name: GetOrCreateStream
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a stream with the specified ID.

methods.name: GetLocallyClosedStreamsHighestOffset
methods.description: Provides access to the map of locally closed streams with their highest offsets.

methods.name: stream_map
methods.description: Access to the map of streams within the session.

methods.name: closed_streams
methods.description: Access to the set of closed streams.

methods.name: ActivateStream
methods.description: Activates a stream within the session.

methods.name: IsStreamClosed
methods.description: Checks if a stream is closed.

methods.name: IsStreamCreated
methods.description: Checks if a stream has been created.

methods.name: IsStreamAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a stream ID is available for use.

methods.name: GetStream
methods.description: Retrieves a stream by ID.

methods.name: IsStreamWriteBlocked
methods.description: Checks if a stream is write-blocked.

methods.name: GetCleanUpClosedStreamsAlarm
methods.description: Returns the alarm for cleaning up closed streams.

methods.name: GetStreamIdManager
methods.description: Access to the stream ID manager.

methods.name: ietf_streamid_manager
methods.description: Access to the IETF stream ID manager.

methods.name: ietf_bidirectional_stream_id_manager
methods.description: Access to the bidirectional stream ID manager.

methods.name: ietf_unidirectional_stream_id_manager
methods.description: Access to the unidirectional stream ID manager.

methods.name: GetPendingStream
methods.description: Retrieves a pending stream by ID.

methods.name: set_is_configured
methods.description: Sets the configuration state of the session.

methods.name: SetPerspective
methods.description: Sets the perspective (client/server) of the session.

methods.name: GetNumOpenDynamicStreams
methods.description: Returns the number of open dynamic streams.

methods.name: GetNumDrainingStreams
methods.description: Returns the number of draining streams.
